pvp.title: PvP
query: SELECT characters.obj_Id AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.base_class AS class_id, characters.`level`, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id WHERE characters.accesslevel = 0 ORDER BY characters.pvpkills DESC LIMIT 10

pk.title: PK
query: SELECT characters.obj_Id AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.base_class AS class_id, characters.`level`, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id WHERE characters.accesslevel = 0 ORDER BY characters.pkkills DESC LIMIT 10

online.title: Online
query: SELECT characters.obj_Id AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.base_class AS class_id, characters.`level`, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id WHERE characters.accesslevel = 0 ORDER BY characters.onlinetime DESC LIMIT 10;

exp.title: EXP
query: SELECT characters.obj_Id AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.base_class AS class_id, characters.`level`, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id WHERE characters.accesslevel = 0 ORDER BY characters.exp DESC LIMIT 10;

clan.title: Clans
query: SELECT clan_data.hasCastle AS castle_id, clan_data.reputation_score, clan_data.leader_id, characters.char_name AS `player_name`, characters.pvpkills AS `pvp`, characters.pkkills AS `pk`, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS `time_in_game`, characters.sex, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM characters WHERE clanid = clan_data.clan_id) AS clan_count_members FROM clan_data INNER JOIN characters ON clan_data.leader_id = characters.obj_Id

castle.title: Castle
query: SELECT castle.id AS castle_id, castle.taxPercent AS tax, castle.treasury, castle.siegeDate AS siege_date, clan_data.`clan_name` AS clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.char_name AS player_name, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest FROM castle LEFT JOIN clan_data ON castle.id = clan_data.hasCastle LEFT JOIN characters ON clan_data.leader_id = characters.obj_Id

account_characters.title: Account Characters
query: SELECT characters.obj_id AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, characters.base_class AS class_id, characters.`level`, clan_data.clan_name as `name`, clan_data.clan_level, null AS clan_crest, null AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id WHERE characters.account_name = ?

admin_account_list.title: Admin Account List
query: SELECT email AS email, login FROM accounts ORDER BY login;

character_items.title: Character Items
query: SELECT object_id, item_id, count, enchant_level, loc AS location FROM items WHERE owner_id = ? ORDER BY loc, item_id;

plugin_get_farm_top.title: Farm Top
query: SELECT items.item_id AS item_id, SUM(items.count) AS total_count, (SELECT owner_id FROM items AS sub_items WHERE sub_items.item_id = items.item_id GROUP BY sub_items.owner_id ORDER BY SUM(sub_items.count) DESC LIMIT 1) AS top_owner_id, (SELECT char_name FROM characters WHERE obj_Id = (SELECT owner_id FROM items AS sub_items WHERE sub_items.item_id = items.item_id GROUP BY sub_items.owner_id ORDER BY SUM(sub_items.count) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS top_owner_name, (SELECT SUM(count) FROM items AS owner_items WHERE owner_items.item_id = items.item_id AND owner_items.owner_id = (SELECT owner_id FROM items AS sub_items WHERE sub_items.item_id = items.item_id GROUP BY sub_items.owner_id ORDER BY SUM(sub_items.count) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS top_owner_item_count FROM items WHERE items.item_id IN (%s) GROUP BY items.item_id;
